customManagers.description: Track the rokucommunity/vscode-brightscript-language release whose TextMate grammar we vendor in dev-docs/src/syntaxes/. When Renovate bumps the ref, the sync-brightscript-grammar workflow re-fetches the JSON so the PR contains both changes atomically.

Track the pinned shared-ui release that shared/fetch-shared-ui.mjs clones at build time. It follows the org preset like any dependency: patch automerges after its soak once CI is green; minor and major wait for review (see packageRules).

packageRules.description: CI is build+lint only, so minors need human review (renovate/README.md, Automerge contract, point 3): a breaking minor can pass the build and fail in the browser. Patch and digest still automerge. Remove this rule once browser tests are a required check here (jellyrock/.github#11).
Label vendored-grammar bumps so they're easy to spot in the queue; do not automerge — humans review the upstream release notes before adopting.

TypeScript 7 is held back (#42): typescript-eslint (8.72.0, the latest on 2026-10-23) accepts typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0 and @astrojs/check (0.9.12) accepts ^5 || ^6, so npm can't install 7 beside them. Renovate offers 6.x instead. Same rule as jellyrock.app. Remove this rule once both accept 7 (check: npm view typescript-eslint peerDependencies; npm view @astrojs/check peerDependencies).
